plugin.name: ModelScope
plugin.description: ModelScope's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds ModelScope to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from ModelScope, so new models show up by themselves.
config.apiKey.title: ModelScope API key
config.apiKey.description: Your access token from modelscope.cn → Account → Access Token. It has a free daily quota once an Alibaba Cloud account is linked.
